biography: Kenneth Leonard is a GAFAI Delegate and Generative AI Engineer specializing in UN Responsible AI Governance, global leadership, and climate AI. With 25+ years bridging technology and sustainable development across Africa, he holds UN-certified credentials in Responsible AI (UNU-EHS), AI Governance & Equity (LinkedIn/UN partners), Disaster Risk Management (UNDRR), and Green Economy Leadership (UNITAR). His work ensures AI systems are ethically governed, climate-resilient, and accountable to the communities they serve.
